0.content: Iansan is Varesa's coach, the Patrol Team commander who gives her orders, and the person she looks up to most. She noticed Varesa when a hilichurl's club, knocked flying by Varesa's charge, hit her on the head. She took over Varesa's training, judged her talent greater than her own and steered her from weapons to wrestling. Her first standard meal plan left Varesa too hungry to make it to class, so she studied Varesa's eating and tailored it. She calls Varesa her star student, says Varesa can lift more than she can, and thinks all Varesa lacks is confidence. Her refrain is that power is all about control.

1.content: Fietena is an old heroine of the Collective of Plenty and Varesa's favourite hero since childhood. Known as "The Fearless Rock", she was famed for speed, close combat and a red battle mask. She defended other tribes as well as her own, and married a Flower-Feather Clan warrior, which strengthened the bond between the two tribes. Varesa learned simple crafts from the Children of Echoes and made replicas of all five of Fietena's comic mask designs. The one she wears is based on Fietena's mask from the Night Warden Wars: Second Trial. Fietena was then not yet the Fearless Rock, yet she overcame her fear. Because the comic showed it only from the side, Varesa finished the pattern by instinct.

2.content: In the Collective of Plenty's Tribal Chronicles story (5.5), Varesa guided the Traveler and Paimon to her tribe, showed them her family orchard and served them its fruit and fast-growing, fruity-tasting mushrooms. After an eating contest, a green mushroom she grilled let the Traveler hear a voice calling itself the Sage-Lord of Fungi. Varesa could hear it too, because she had eaten so many over the years. Encouraged by the Traveler, she chose to investigate, reported to Chief Acatl, and fetched volcanic heat sources: Avatar of Lava cores and the shell of a Furnace Shell Mountain Weasel.

key: Abyss assault on the Collective of Plenty
3.content: Varesa awoke her Electro Vision in her second month on the Patrol Team. The Abyss launched a three-pronged attack on the Collective of Plenty during the Tollan Volcano's eruption cycle, aiming to cut off and exterminate the tribe's warriors. With only a few Scions of the Canopy couriers as reinforcements, the elders layered the defences and sent elite counterattacks to kill the Abyssal leaders. Varesa signed up at once. The squads shrank with each strike until only she remained beside Iansan. She put on her tattered mask, whispered that she was no longer a scared little girl, and smashed through to the enemy leader.

4.comment: Varesa: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
4.content: Everyone expected Varesa to shine in the Pilgrimage, but she has never thought of other tribes' warriors as enemies. She fears hurting them and fights like a spectator. In five attempts she never left the team stage. A Seit'aad warrior deflected her into a cave, where she got lost; she stopped to applaud Nusta of the Flower-Feather Clan while Nusta's team stole the Sacred Flame; Kinich dodged until she was exhausted and took her team's Flame. Her family greeted each loss with a feast, and even rival tribes were sympathetic. She says the stares of contestants in the team stage are the only time she feels uncomfortable anywhere.

5.content: The Legion of Soulblazers is Varesa's circle of comics-loving pen pals from several nations, devoted to The Soulblazer Saga. This 12-volume Yae Publishing House comic dramatises Natlan's fight against the Abyss through Fietena's arc. Varesa leads it as "captain" and says its purpose is to share life's joys and get rid of life's woes. Members include the Sumeru student Alrani, Tang Yigang, the young Mondstadt artist Minnie and Xilonen's relative Nepecha. Xilonen became vice captain without quite agreeing to it.

6.content: Varesa learned crafts at Muhuru's Gemporium of the Children of Echoes, where she grew fond of Xilonen's catchy playlist long before they really spoke. They became friends when Varesa came to commission work and found Nepecha reading The Soulblazer Saga. Their excited chatter woke Xilonen, who ended up reading with them deep into the night and fell asleep between them. Varesa calls Xilonen a real hero and teases her for buying comic "merch" with a straight face.

7.content: Varesa's family orchard lies just outside the Collective of Plenty, near the main road, with the fruit stand in front of their house. Volcanic soil makes the fruit superb. They sell to every tribe from the Children of Echoes to the Flower-Feather Clan, give some to friends and keep the rest. Vanana, a female Tatankasaurus, has been with Varesa since infancy. As a baby Varesa rode on her back while her mother followed her father through the trees. Vanana now guards the orchard and turns strangers away, but treats Varesa's friends as welcome guests.

8.comment: Varesa: Appetite and the Inferno Stomach Supremo
8.content: Varesa's appetite is legendary. She was champion of the Inferno Stomach Supremo eating contest (80 servings, per the 5.0 bulletin boards) and entered other tribes' preliminaries just for the food. The Epic Feast Showdown has a separate "Varesa Challenge" plate that, Acatl says, even the Pyro Archon could not finish. It began when the Speaker's Chamber suspected fraud over a single order for a crowd, then watched Varesa eat it all. Mavuika, who pays the Weary Inn bills during the Pilgrimage, learned the tray for eighty was hers alone.

9.comment: Varesa: Citlali and the Drunken Witch Legend
9.content: Varesa knew "Granny Itztli" of the Masters of the Night-Wind only as a revered hero from comic letters columns, so she did not recognise the young-looking Citlali. Finding her drunk and penniless in a tavern, Varesa paid the bill, slung her over a shoulder and carried her to the Masters of the Night-Wind, asking door to door at night for "Granny Itztli", until the horrified looks made her suspect something was wrong. In Citlali's version it became a beloved urban legend of a masked hero rescuing a drunken witch. Citlali claims not to care and wishes her ten days of nothing but mushrooms.

10.content: Escoffier's restaurant orders Varesa's fruit in bulk, samples every batch and rejects the lot if sweetness is slightly off. She still says the fruit is worth twenty percent more and always treats Varesa to a meal, which Varesa thinks only a god could afford daily. Dori haggles thirty to forty percent off every purchase but buys several cartloads at once and lets Varesa pet her fluffy Shaggy Sumpter Beast.
